title: Open Source Kigali (OSK Frontend)
tagline: The official website for Open Source Kigali — Rwanda's growing open-source developer community.
shortDescription: Community portal showcasing developer events, hackathons, open-source projects, and contributor onboarding for Rwanda's tech talent.
problemStatement: The developer community in Kigali needed a centralized, modern web platform to announce technical meetups, onboard new contributors, showcase local open-source software, and foster active collaboration among Rwandan programmers.
role: Frontend Developer & Contributor — Engineered the user interface, responsive layout, event highlight sections, and contributor showcase using Vite, React, and TypeScript.
architecture: Built with Vite and React using TypeScript in strict mode for strong type safety and rapid builds. Styled with Tailwind CSS for high-contrast accessibility across both mobile and desktop screens. Deployed with automated CI workflows via GitHub Actions.
features: Dynamic meetup announcements and interactive event schedules
Community member onboarding directory and contributor highlight reel
Responsive navigation drawer tailored for smartphone browsing
Partnership and workshop showcase with official OSK branding

screenshots.caption: Official Open Source Kigali hero banner and platform overview taken from Mustivo/osk-frontend.
Open Source Kigali youth meetup in Kigali, empowering local developer talent.

title: OSK Backend API Service
tagline: Containerized REST API powering the Open Source Kigali community website and membership workflows.
shortDescription: High-availability backend service built with Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL, containerized with Docker.
problemStatement: The Open Source Kigali platform required a reliable, decoupled REST API to manage attendee registrations, community contributors, event calendars, and Cloudinary media assets with robust database migrations.
role: Backend Engineer — Implemented Express routes, Prisma schema definitions, PostgreSQL relationships, and Docker orchestration.
architecture: Engineered in TypeScript on Node.js using Express with Prisma ORM connecting to PostgreSQL. Includes OpenAPI Swagger documentation, Vitest test suites, and Docker Compose for instant reproducible development environments.
features: Type-safe database models for events, users, and community contributions
Docker Compose environment setup for database and application containers
Interactive Swagger UI API documentation
Vitest automated unit and integration testing suite

screenshots.caption: Open Source Kigali official logo taken from the community repository assets.
Decoupled frontend-backend API microservice architecture diagram.

title: MovieApplication (Expo & React Native)
tagline: Cross-platform mobile movie application built with React Native and Expo.
shortDescription: Mobile app featuring movie discovery, category browsing, trailer previews, and watchlists developed during the Solvit Africa fellowship.
problemStatement: Movie enthusiasts needed a smooth, lightweight cross-platform mobile application to discover trending movies, view ratings, explore casts, and manage their personal watchlists seamlessly on Android and iOS.
role: Mobile Developer — Built reusable React Native components, navigation flows, state management, and API data consumers.
architecture: Developed using Expo and React Native with TypeScript. Utilizes Expo Router for navigation, responsive card layouts, and asynchronous REST API integration for real-time cinema catalogs.
features: Cross-platform support for Android and iOS using Expo
Reusable UI components with fluid touch feedback and card animations
Movie search with real-time filtering and category sliders
Navigation stack handling movie detail pages and trailer views

title: Citizen Engagement & Feedback Portal
tagline: Civic reporting web portal for citizens to submit feedback and track resolution status.
shortDescription: Full-stack PHP and MySQL platform allowing citizens and customers to submit complaints, attach inquiries, and track administrative responses.
problemStatement: Citizens and customers lacked an accessible digital platform to submit feedback or complaints regarding local services and follow up on the resolution progress in a transparent manner.
role: Full Stack Developer — Created the submission forms, database connection layer, response tracking pages, and administrative dashboard.
architecture: Constructed with PHP connecting to a relational MySQL database. Employs Bootstrap for mobile-friendly input forms, status verification scripts (`status.php`), and admin dashboards (`admin/dashboard.php`).
features: User feedback and complaint submission form with field validation
Real-time complaint status tracking page via unique ticket IDs
Administrative dashboard to review, update, and resolve submitted issues
Responsive layout accessible on mobile devices and public internet terminals

screenshots.caption: Complaint submission and resolution tracking workflow for Citizen Engagement.

title: Stivo Maize & Crop Management System
tagline: Agricultural web system for tracking maize crop production, inventory, and sales records.
shortDescription: PHP & MySQL web application enabling farmers and inventory managers to insert, view, update, and manage maize agricultural yields.
problemStatement: Agricultural producers struggled with paper-based records for maize harvests, stock changes, and distribution sales, resulting in inventory discrepancies and lost revenue.
role: Full Stack Developer — Designed the database schemas, user authentication (login/signup), and complete CRUD operations for maize records.
architecture: Built with PHP and MySQL utilizing dedicated endpoints for data insertion (`insertmaiz.php`), records retrieval (`selectmaize.php`), updates (`up.php`), and deletion (`deletemaize.php`), backed by custom CSS styling.
features: Complete CRUD capabilities for recording harvested maize yields and inventory levels
User authentication module with secure login, signup, and logout workflows
Clean tabular summary displaying current stock and historical records
Lightweight architecture requiring minimal bandwidth in rural settings

title: ZoraShop Rwanda - Online Marketplace
tagline: Consumer e-commerce platform built for Rwandan shoppers with localized product discovery.
shortDescription: Responsive online retail platform featuring categorized product catalogs, shopping cart management, and streamlined checkout.
problemStatement: Rwandan consumers needed a fast, accessible digital retail site allowing them to browse products, view details in Rwandan Francs (RWF), and place orders with minimal data consumption.
role: Creator & Lead Developer — Created the digital storefront, catalog structure, cart state, and order messaging system.
architecture: Optimized responsive web platform built for high speed and accessibility over mobile networks, deployed at zorashoprwanda.infinityfreeapp.com.
features: Instant product discovery across consumer and tech categories
Shopping cart with real-time total calculation
Mobile-optimized browsing designed for Rwandan smartphone users
Direct ordering integration and contact options
